favicons 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Adds the ability to generate multi-platform website icons using the Node.js favicons library.
- Supports creation of app icons, manifest files, and HTML tags for various platforms (iOS, Android, Windows).
- Includes scripts and documentation for quick start, configuration, and output details.
- Provides FAQs and troubleshooting tips for common icon generation issues.
